items.title: Install and run
items.body:
pip install "fastapi[standard]"
fastapi dev main.py
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
items.description: Install with the standard extras and start the dev server.

items.title: Minimal app
items.description: A single file API; docs appear at /docs.

items.title: Routers
items.body:
# app/routers/items.py
from fastapi import APIRouter

router = APIRouter(prefix="/items", tags=["items"])


@router.get("/")
def list_items():
    return []

# app/main.py
from fastapi import FastAPI
from .routers import items

app = FastAPI()
app.include_router(items.router)

items.title: OAuth2 bearer dependency skeleton
items.body:
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")


async def current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]):
    user = decode_and_load_user(token)      # your JWT/session logic
    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid token",
                            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"})
    return user
items.description: Extract the token and resolve the user.

items.title: Lifespan: startup and shutdown
items.body:
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    app.state.pool = await create_pool()
    yield
    await app.state.pool.close()

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)

items.title: Settings with pydantic-settings
items.body:
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=".env")
    database_url: str
    debug: bool = False


settings = Settings()
items.description: Typed configuration from environment variables and .env.

items.title: Testing with TestClient
items.body:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)


def test_root():
    response = client.get("/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {"status": "ok"}
items.description: Call the app without running a server.

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = get_test_db
# cleanup after the test:
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
items.description: Swap the database or auth for tests.

items.title: async vs def endpoints
items.body:
async def: use when you await async libraries (httpx, asyncpg, async SQLAlchemy).
def: use for blocking code (regular SQLAlchemy, requests); FastAPI runs it in a thread pool.
Never call blocking code inside async def: it stalls the whole event loop.

items.title: Run with several workers
items.body:
fastapi run main.py --workers 4
uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 4
gunicorn app.main:app -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker -w 4 -b 127.0.0.1:8000
